A systematic meta-analysis of genetic, regional, and production determinants of global pork quality

Code and model outputs - Marbling Score

1 Loading packages and data

## load the packages
library(metafor)
library(orchaRd)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(MuMIn)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
## Load the functions from the script file
source("functions.R")
## Load the data for Marbling Score
data_MS <- read.csv("MS.csv")

## Convert columns to appropriate numeric types
data_MS$Mean <- as.numeric(data_MS$Mean)
data_MS$SD <- as.numeric(data_MS$SD)
data_MS$Sample <- as.numeric(data_MS$Sample)
data_MS$Age <- as.numeric(data_MS$Age)
data_MS$Weight <- as.numeric(data_MS$Weight)
data_MS$Digestible_energy <- as.numeric(data_MS$Digestible_energy)
data_MS$Crude_protein <- as.numeric(data_MS$Crude_protein)
data_MS$Crude_fat <- as.numeric(data_MS$Crude_fat)
data_MS$Crude_fiber <- as.numeric(data_MS$Crude_fiber)
data_MS$Ash <- as.numeric(data_MS$Ash)
data_MS$Lys <- as.numeric(data_MS$Lys)
data_MS$Met_and_Cys <- as.numeric(data_MS$Met_and_Cys)
data_MS$Thr <- as.numeric(data_MS$Thr)
data_MS$Try <- as.numeric(data_MS$Try)
data_MS$Val <- as.numeric(data_MS$Val)
data_MS$Dry_matter <- as.numeric(data_MS$Dry_matter)
data_MS$Ca <- as.numeric(data_MS$Ca)
data_MS$P <- as.numeric(data_MS$P)
data_MS$Na <- as.numeric(data_MS$Na)

## Convert columns to factor types
data_MS$Position <- factor(data_MS$Position)
data_MS$Breed <- factor(data_MS$Breed)
data_MS$Class <- factor(data_MS$Class)
data_MS$Sex <- factor(data_MS$Sex)
data_MS$Region <- factor(data_MS$Region) 
data_MS$Aim <- factor(data_MS$Aim)
data_MS$Multiple_breeds <- factor(data_MS$Multiple_breeds)

## Calculate variance (rVar)
# rVar is the square of the standard error (SD/sqrt(Sample))
data_MS$rVar <- (data_MS$SD/sqrt(data_MS$Sample))^2

2 Testing random effects

## Run VCV matrix for all data
VCV_MS_AllData <- make_VCV_matrix(data_MS, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")

## Null model with VCV matrix:
# This model includes random effects for RowID (observation-level) and StudyID.
null_MS_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_MS, method = "ML")
summary(null_MS_mod) #-867.5144          
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 563; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  436.7572  2856.3466  -867.5144  -854.5145  -867.4714   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0043  0.0656    563     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0148  0.1218    274     no  StudyID 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 562) = 929061.9987, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   0.3394  0.0082  41.3948  <.0001  0.3233  0.3555  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## Test whether Region should be a random effect:
# Adds Region as a random effect to the null model structure.
Re_MS_mod <- rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID,
                                     ~1 |Region), 
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_MS, method = "ML")
summary(Re_MS_mod) #-865.5144             
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 563; method: ML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  436.7572  2856.3466  -865.5144  -848.1812  -865.4427   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed   factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0043  0.0656    563     no    RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0148  0.1218    274     no  StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0000  0.0000     37     no   Region 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 562) = 929061.9987, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub

## Full model with fixed effects for Position, Breed, Region, and Class
MS_full_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Position + Breed + Region + Class, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_MS, method = "ML")
R2_Full <- round(r2_ml(MS_full_mod)*100, 2)
anova(MS_full_mod,null_MS_mod)
## 
##          df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik      LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    212 -872.6454   46.0099 -614.6111 648.3227                  38343.2179 
## Reduced   3 -867.5144 -854.5145 -867.4714 436.7572 423.1310 <.0001 929061.9987
## Model with Position as a fixed effect
MS_Position_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                          mods = ~Position,
                          random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                        ~1 |StudyID),
                          sparse = TRUE,
                          data = data_MS, method = "ML")
R2_Position <-round(r2_ml(MS_Position_mod)*100, 2)
anova(MS_Position_mod,null_MS_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik     LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    13 -880.8224 -824.4898 -880.1594 453.4112                314568.6842 
## Reduced  3 -867.5144 -854.5145 -867.4714 436.7572 33.3080 0.0002 929061.9987
## Model with Breed as a fixed effect
MS_Breed_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Breed,

                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,

R2_Breed <- round(r2_ml(MS_Breed_mod)*100, 2)
anova(MS_Breed_mod,null_MS_mod)

## Reduced   3 -867.5144 -854.5145 -867.4714 436.7572 309.4647 <.0001 929061.9987
## Model with Region as a fixed effect
MS_Region_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                      mods = ~Region, 
                      random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID),
                      sparse = TRUE,
                      data = data_MS, method = "ML")
R2_Region <- round(r2_ml(MS_Region_mod)*100, 2) 
anova(MS_Region_mod,null_MS_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik     LRT   pval          QE

## Reduced  3 -867.5144 -854.5145 -867.4714 436.7572 53.8856 0.0280 929061.9987
## Model with Class as a fixed effect
MS_Class_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                       mods = ~Class,
                       random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                     ~1 |StudyID),
                       sparse = TRUE,
                       data = data_MS, method = "ML")
R2_Class <- round(r2_ml(MS_Class_mod)*100, 2)
anova(MS_Class_mod,null_MS_mod)
## 
##         df       AIC       BIC      AICc   logLik     LRT   pval          QE 
## Full    12 -875.0028 -823.0034 -874.4355 449.5014                294088.4052 
## Reduced  3 -867.5144 -854.5145 -867.4714 436.7572 25.4884 0.0025 929061.9987
## Create a table of R-squared values for models with moderators
R2_models_summary <- data.frame("Model" = c("Full",
                                     "Position",
                                     "Breed",
                                     "Region", 
                                     "Class"),
                         "R2" = c(R2_Full[1],
                                  R2_Position[1],
                                  R2_Breed[1],
                                  R2_Region[1], 
                                  R2_Class[1]))
R2_models_summary <- R2_models_summary %>% 
  transmute(Model = Model
            ,R2= round(R2,2))

colnames(R2_models_summary)[2] <- "$R^2(\\%)$"

R2_models_summary %>% 
  kable(format="html", escape=F, caption="Heterogeneity explained in the models with moderators") %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

## Refit with REML for reporting in Manuscript
REML_MS_mod<-rma.mv(yi = Mean, V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
                        random = list(~1 |RowID,
                                      ~1 |StudyID,
                                      ~1 |Breed,
                                      # ~1 | Region, # Region was not better than null in initial test
                                      ~1 |Position),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        data = data_MS, method = "REML")
summary(REML_MS_mod)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 563; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  448.7645  -897.5291  -887.5291  -865.8716  -887.4212   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0030  0.0548    563     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0145  0.1206    274     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0020  0.0450    167     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.4  0.0035  0.0592     11     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 562) = 929061.9987, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval   ci.lb   ci.ub      
##   0.3607  0.0259  13.9078  <.0001  0.3098  0.4115  *** 
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
# Calculate I-squared values
round(i2_ml(REML_MS_mod), 2)
##    I2_Total    I2_RowID  I2_StudyID    I2_Breed I2_Position 
##       99.98       13.01       63.02        8.77       15.17
# Calculate R-squared
round(r2_ml(REML_MS_mod)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.00          86.99
## Generate orchard plot for the REML model
p_REML_MS <- orchard_plot(REML_MS_mod,
                               group = "StudyID",  
                               xlab = "Mean Marbling Score", 
                               cb = FALSE,
                               angle = 0,
                               legend.pos = "bottom.out",
                               branch.size = 1.5)
print(p_REML_MS)

3 Meta-regression

3.1 Breed

## Filter data for breeds with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_MS_B3 <- data_MS %>%
  group_by(Breed) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered breed data
VCV_MS_B3_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_MS_B3, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_breed <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Position)

# Model with intercept
Br_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_MS_B3_Data,
  mods = ~ Breed,
  random = random_structure_breed,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_MS_B3)
summary(Br_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 339; method: REML)

## Generate table of pairwise comparisons for Breed using all_models function
res_MS_Br <- all_models(

3.2 Class

## Filter data for Class with at least 3 distinct StudyIDs
data_MS_Cl <- data_MS %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(StudyID) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## Create VCV matrix for the filtered Class data
VCV_MS_Cl_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_MS_Cl, 
                                   V = "rVar", 
                                   cluster = "StudyID", 
                                   obs = "RowID")
## Define random structure
random_structure_class <- list(~1 |RowID,
                               ~1 |StudyID,
                               ~1 |Breed,
                               ~1 |Position)
  
# Model with intercept
Cl_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int <- rma.mv(
  yi = Mean,
  V = VCV_MS_Cl_Data,
  mods = ~ Class,
  random = random_structure_class,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  data = data_MS_Cl)
summary(Cl_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 558; method: REML)
##

## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0029  0.0541    558     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0141  0.1188    271     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0023  0.0480    163     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.4  0.0035  0.0593     11     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 552) = 293960.4899, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficients 2:6):
## F(df1 = 5, df2 = 552) = 2.0262, p-val = 0.0734
##

3.6 Age

## Filter data for complete cases of Age
data_MS_Age <- data_MS[complete.cases(data_MS$Age), ]

## Create VCV matrix for Age data
VCV_MS_Age_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_MS_Age, 
                                    V = "rVar", 
                                    cluster = "StudyID", 
                                    obs = "RowID")
## Define common random structure for continuous moderators
random_structure_continuous <- list(~1 |RowID,
                                    ~1 |StudyID,
                                    ~1 |Breed, 
                                    ~1 |Position)

## Run meta-regression for Age
res_MS_Age <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_MS_Age,          
  mod_var     = "Age",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_MS_Age",              
  x_lab       = "Age (Days)",
  y_lab       = "Mean Marbling Score" 
)

## Generate summary table for Age models
mods_list_age <- attr(res_MS_Age$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_age   <- res_MS_Age$aic_table                   

tbl_MS_Age <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_age, aic_tab_age, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Age models
html_table_age <- tbl_MS_Age %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_age)

3.16 Val

## Filter data for complete cases of Valine (Val)
data_MS_Val <- data_MS[complete.cases(data_MS$Val), ]
 
## Create VCV matrix for Valine data
VCV_MS_Val_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_MS_Val, 
                                     V = "rVar", 
                                     cluster = "StudyID", 
                                     obs = "RowID")
# 1. Data Preparation
data_MS_Val <- data_MS_Val %>%
  filter(!is.na(Val), !is.na(Mean), !is.na(rVar)) %>%
  mutate(
    mu     = mean(Val, na.rm = TRUE),
    Val_c   = Val - mu,
    Val_c2  = Val_c^2,
    Prec   = 1 / sqrt(rVar)
  )

VCV_MS_Val_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(
  data_MS_Val,
  V       = "rVar",
  cluster = "StudyID",
  obs     = "RowID"
)

# 2. Model Fitting & Selection
rand_layers <- list(~1|RowID, ~1|StudyID, ~1|Breed, ~1|Position)
ctrl <- list(optimizer="optim", optmethod="BFGS", maxiter=2000, reltol=1e-8)

fit0 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_MS_Val_Data, mods = ~1,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_MS_Val,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit1 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_MS_Val_Data, mods = ~Val_c,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_MS_Val,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)
fit2 <- rma.mv(Mean, VCV_MS_Val_Data, mods = ~Val_c + Val_c2,
               random = rand_layers, data = data_MS_Val,
               method="ML", test="t", control=ctrl)

ms_tab <- model.sel(list(fit0=fit0, fit1=fit1, fit2=fit2), rank="AICc")
print(ms_tab, digits=3)
## Model selection table 
##      (Int)     mods df logLik  AICc delta weight
## fit0     +           5 16.508 -13.0  0.00  0.986
## fit1     +      V_c  6 16.633  -4.5  8.55  0.014
## fit2     + V_c+V_c2  7 16.670   8.7 21.68  0.000
## Abbreviations:
##  mods:  = '~1', V_c = '~Val_c', V_c+V_c2 = '~Val_c+Val_c2'
## Models ranked by AICc(x)
anova(fit0, fit1)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC     AICc  logLik    LRT   pval       QE 
## Full     6 -21.2660 -18.3565  -4.4660 16.6330               355.7132 
## Reduced  5 -23.0168 -20.5923 -13.0168 16.5084 0.2492 0.6177 672.0654
anova(fit1, fit2)
## 
##         df      AIC      BIC    AICc  logLik    LRT   pval       QE 
## Full     7 -19.3393 -15.9449  8.6607 16.6696               161.2080 
## Reduced  6 -21.2660 -18.3565 -4.4660 16.6330 0.0733 0.7866 355.7132
best_key <- rownames(ms_tab)[1]   # “fit0” / “fit1” / “fit2”
best_mod <- switch(best_key,
                   fit0 = update(fit0, method="REML"),
                   fit1 = update(fit1, method="REML"),
                   fit2 = update(fit2, method="REML"))

# 3. Plotting Functions
plot_linear <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Val, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Val = seq(min(df$Val), max(df$Val), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    Val_c = Val - mu
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=newdat$Val_c)
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  beta1 <- coef(model)["Val_c"]
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["Val_c"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Val, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Val, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Val, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Na)+.03*diff(range(df$Na)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("β = %.3f\nR² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g",
                           beta1, R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Na (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1))
}

plot_quadratic <- function(model, df) {
  mu   <- mean(df$Val, na.rm=TRUE)
  newdat <- data.frame(
    Val = seq(min(df$Val), max(df$Val), length.out=200)
  ) %>% mutate(
    Val_c  = Val - mu,
    Val_c2 = Val_c^2
  )
  ci   <- predict(model, newmods=as.matrix(newdat[,c("Val_c","Val_c2")]))
  newdat <- newdat %>% mutate(
    fit    = ci$pred,
    ci_lwr = ci$ci.lb,
    ci_upr = ci$ci.ub
  )
  b1    <- coef(model)["Val_c"]
  b2    <- coef(model)["Val_c2"]
  x_opt <- -b1/(2*b2) + mu
  p_val <- summary(model)$pval["Val_c2"]
  R2m   <- r2_ml(model)["R2_marginal"]*100
  
  ggplot(df, aes(Val, Mean)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=Prec), shape=21, fill="grey65",
               colour="black", stroke=.25, alpha=.6) +
    scale_size_continuous(range=c(.5,4), name="Precision\n(1/SE)") +
    geom_ribbon(data=newdat,
                aes(x=Val, ymin=ci_lwr, ymax=ci_upr),
                fill="grey85", alpha=.5) +
    geom_line(data=newdat,
              aes(x=Val, y=fit),
              colour="firebrick", linewidth=.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=x_opt,
               linetype="dNaed", colour="red3",
               linewidth=.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Val)+.02*diff(range(df$Val)),
             y=max(df$Mean)-.03*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("Val = %.1f%%", x_opt),
             hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x=min(df$Val)+.03*diff(range(df$Val)),
             y=min(df$Mean)+.07*diff(range(df$Mean)),
             label=sprintf("R² = %.2f%%\nP = %.3g", R2m, p_val),
             colour="blue4", hjust=0, size=3.2) +
    labs(x="Val (% DM)", y="Aspartic acid (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size=11) +
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(colour="black", fill=NA),
          axis.ticks.length=unit(0.15,"cm"),
          legend.position=c(.98,.99),
          legend.justification=c(1,1)) +
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE)
}

# 4. Plotting based on best model
if (best_key == "fit1") {
  print(plot_linear(best_mod, data_MS_Val))
} else if (best_key == "fit2") {
  print(plot_quadratic(best_mod, data_MS_Val))
} else {
  message("No significant effect of Na")
}

mods <- list(
  Linear    = fit1,
  Quadratic = fit2,
  Null      = fit0
)

aic_tab <- ms_tab                          

map_names <- c(fit0 = "Null", fit1 = "Linear", fit2 = "Quadratic")
rownames(aic_tab) <- map_names[rownames(aic_tab)]

best_row   <- rownames(aic_tab)[1]
best_label <- c(Null="Null", Linear="Linear", Quadratic="Quadratic")[best_row]


tbl_MS_Val <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mods), function(label){
  m <- mods[[label]]
  R2m <- r2_ml(m)["R2_marginal"] * 100
  
  if (label == "Linear") {               
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[2]              
  } else if (label == "Quadratic") {      
    p_val <- summary(m)$pval[3]             
  } else {                                
    p_val <- NA
  }
  
  AICc  <- aic_tab[label, "AICc"]
  delta <- aic_tab[label, "delta"]
  
  data.frame(
    Model         = label,
    Adjusted_R2   = round(R2m, 2),
    P_value       = signif(p_val, 3),
    AICc          = round(AICc, 2),
    Delta_AICc    = round(delta, 2),
    Selected_Model= ifelse(label == best_label, "✔", "")
  )
}))


print(tbl_MS_Val)
##                     Model Adjusted_R2 P_value   AICc Delta_AICc Selected_Model
## R2_marginal...1    Linear        3.39   0.618  -4.47       8.55               
## R2_marginal...2 Quadratic        4.44   0.787   8.66      21.68               
## R2_marginal...3      Null        0.00      NA -13.02       0.00              ✔

)
## Display summary table for Lys_DE_Ratio models
html_table_lys_de <- tbl_MS_Lys_DE_ratio %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_lys_de)

3.24 Ca_P_ratio

## Filter data for non-missing Calcium and Phosphorus, then calculate ratio
data_MS_Ca_P_ratio <- data_MS %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Ca),
    !is.na(P),
    P != 0 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Ca_P_Ratio = Ca / P
  )

## Create VCV matrix for Ca_P_Ratio data
VCV_MS_Ca_P_Data <- make_VCV_matrix(data_MS_Ca_P_ratio, 
                                     V = "rVar", 
                                     cluster = "StudyID", 
                                     obs = "RowID")
## Run meta-regression for Ca_P_Ratio
res_MS_Ca_P_ratio <- run_meta_ct(
  dat         = data_MS_Ca_P_ratio,          
  mod_var     = "Ca_P_Ratio",
  random_list = random_structure_continuous, 
  plot_name   = "p_MS_Ca_P_ratio",              
  x_lab       = "Ratio of calcium to phosphorus",
  y_lab       = "Mean Marbling Score" 
)

## Generate summary table for Ca_P_Ratio models
mods_list_ca_p <- attr(res_MS_Ca_P_ratio$best_model, "mods_list") 
aic_tab_ca_p   <- res_MS_Ca_P_ratio$aic_table                    

tbl_MS_Ca_P_ratio <- model_summary_tbl(
  mods_list_ca_p, aic_tab_ca_p, 
  lin_coef  = "mod_c",              
  quad_coef = "mod_c2"
)
## Display summary table for Ca_P_Ratio models
html_table_ca_p <- tbl_MS_Ca_P_ratio %>% 
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")  
print(html_table_ca_p)

4 Publication bias and sensitivty analyses

4.1 Decline effect (Publication Year)

## Define random structure
random_structure_Ye <- list(~1 |RowID,
                            ~1 |StudyID,
                            ~1 |Breed, 
                            ~1 |Position) 

## Model with Publication Year (Years) as moderator
Ye_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int <- rma.mv(
   yi = Mean,
   V = VCV_MS_AllData, 
   mods = ~ Years,
   random = random_structure_Ye, 
   test = "t",
   method = "REML",
   data = data_MS)
summary(Ye_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 563; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
##  448.8200  -897.6401  -885.6401  -859.6618  -885.4885   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed    factor 
## sigma^2.1  0.0030  0.0547    563     no     RowID 
## sigma^2.2  0.0146  0.1208    274     no   StudyID 
## sigma^2.3  0.0020  0.0448    167     no     Breed 
## sigma^2.4  0.0037  0.0604     11     no  Position 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 561) = 798988.2656, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficient 2):
## F(df1 = 1, df2 = 561) = 1.5794, p-val = 0.2094
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##          estimate      se     tval   df    pval     ci.lb   ci.ub    
## intrcpt   -6.9988  5.8562  -1.1951  561  0.2326  -18.5016  4.5040    
## Years      0.0036  0.0029   1.2568  561  0.2094   -0.0021  0.0093    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
round(r2_ml(Ye_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int)*100, 2)
##    R2_marginal R2_conditional 
##           0.44          87.17
## Bubble plot for decline effect
p_Ye_VCV_REML_MS <- orchaRd::bubble_plot(Ye_VCV_REML_MS_mod_int, 
                                  mod = "Years",
                                  group = "StudyID",
                                  xlab = "Publication year",
                                  ylab = "Mean Marbling Score", 
                                  g = TRUE)
p_Ye_VCV_REML_MS <- p_Ye_VCV_REML_MS + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2024, by = 2))
print(p_Ye_VCV_REML_MS)
